headline: Binance to Resume Crypto Withdrawals in Phases Following $6B Hack
summary: Binance announced it will resume cryptocurrency withdrawals in phases following a record $6 billion hack.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by volume, making its operational security and solvency pivotal for digital asset liquidity.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Phased reopening of withdrawals alleviates liquidity freeze concerns following a massive security breach.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A phased resumption of client withdrawals at the largest crypto venue helps ease acute solvency fears after a $6 billion exploit.
